title: Delete a store
summary: Remove a store from HQ Admin permanently, and unpublish and delete it from AEM first if AEM is your content management system.
bodyMd:
Deleting a store removes it from Personalisation Hub permanently. Where Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) is your content management system, unpublish and delete the location in AEM first, then delete it in HQ Admin, so the two systems stay matched.

Deletion cannot be undone. Before you delete, move or re-register any displays the store still uses and confirm no staff users still need to sign in to its Retail Admin site.

Before you begin

  • An HQ Admin account with the Admin role.
  • If you use AEM: author and publish access to the location in AEM.

Step 1 (AEM customers only): unpublish and delete the location in AEM

Unpublish the location

  1. Sign in to AEM and go to the location you want to delete.
  2. Select the location's checkbox.
  3. Select Manage Publication.
  4. Select Unpublish.
  5. Follow the standard publication process, then select Unpublish to confirm.
  6. Select Continue. The location is removed from your publish instance.

Delete the location from the author instance

  1. Select the location's checkbox again.
  2. Select Delete.
  3. Confirm Delete.
  4. Confirm Force Delete. The location is now removed from both the author and publish instances.

Step 2: delete the store in Personalisation Hub

  1. In HQ Admin, in the left navigation, select Stores / Branches.
  2. Find the store, using the text search under Store Name if the list is long.
  3. Select the checkbox at the start of the store's row.
  4. In the menu at the top of the list, select Delete.
  5. In the confirmation dialog, select Delete.

Verify it worked

The store no longer appears in the Stores / Branches list and the store count at the top of the page has decreased by 1.
